TurkeyFeather_description: A broad plume from the tail of a turkey.
TurkeyMayonnaise_description: Seems like it would be great on a fall sandwich.
Turkey_description: Happy turkey lay eggs every three days.
TurkeyMeat_description: The meat from a turkey, ready for roasting.
TurkeyRice_description: Rice with shredded turkey and pickles on top.
Turducken_description: An egg stuffed inside a chicken stuffed inside a duck stuffed inside a turkey!
PrimarilyPoultry_description: Read this to learn three turkey themed cooking recipes.
MarnieSpecialOrder_text: What fall season is complete with turkey? If someone is willing to ship some high quality grains, I might be able to convince a local ranch I know to part with some lovely turkey hatchlings at cost. Can someone help me out?
MarnieSpecialOrder_letterbody: Dear @,^Thank you for supporting local ranchers! Every time good quality feed goes to market, it's easier on them to raise healthy baby chicks. If you would like a turkey of your own to raise, please come see me!^   -Marnie
config.Enable Gray Turkey.name: Enable Gray Turkey
config.Enable Gray Turkey.description: Enables the Gray Turkey texture and adds it to the possible turkey appearances.
config.Disable Special Order.name: Disable Special Order
config.Disable Special Order.description: Disables the Special Order to unlock animals at Marnie's. Turn on to have Marnie sell animals by default provided the appropriate housing is built.
config.Disable Meat Recipes.name: Disable Meat Recipes
config.Disable Meat Recipes.description: Disables meat-based recipes/books. Primarily for users who play with Animal Husbandry without having meat/butchering turned on.
